notes.title: Hello everyone! My new game, Nature Atelier, is officially released today
notes.content:
Hello everyone! My new game, Nature Atelier, is officially released today! This is a decorative design game where you can create unique puzzles using various natural specimens. Unlike traditional puzzle games, there are no rules or restrictions here. You can freely choose the patterns you want to work on and the materials for your puzzles, letting your imagination run wild. Feel free to add it to your wishlist if you're interested—thank you for your support!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282200/Nature_Atelier/?curator_clanid=44786890

notes.title: Papercut Art Gallery New Release
notes.content: The second game in the Papercut Art Gallery series has been released! The theme of the second installment is "Growth." We welcome anyone interested to try it out. The game is now available in a bundle, offering even more savings when purchased together!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
1. Modified the operation for picking up puzzle pieces in the game. Now, left-click the mouse to pick up a piece, and left-click again to put it down.
2. Fixed an issue where the game window mode resolution would reset.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
1. Fixed issues with some levels.
2. Windowed mode now allows for freely adjustable resolution.
3. Added a button to directly proceed to the next level after completing a level.
